scripts.build: pnpm db:generate && pnpm --filter @questorylabs/db run build && pnpm --filter @questorylabs/shared run build && pnpm --filter @questorylabs/api --filter @questorylabs/web run build
scripts.db:push: node scripts/migrate-identity-accounts.mjs && pnpm db:schema && pnpm --filter @questorylabs/db exec prisma db push --accept-data-loss
scripts.db:migrate: node scripts/migrate-identity-accounts.mjs && pnpm db:schema && pnpm --filter @questorylabs/db exec prisma migrate dev
scripts.setup: pnpm install && pnpm --filter @questorylabs/shared build && pnpm --filter @questorylabs/db run build && pnpm db:generate && pnpm db:push
scripts.docker:down: docker compose --profile selfhosted --profile selfhosted-full --profile production --profile infra down
